statement: A complete native affine-S3 oracle is integrated into the framework and binary CLI. Producer tests compare every curve target against all signed base-point pairs on four small even/odd fields, including complete subtraction fallback for zero/identity and capped projections. Prefix inverse-square preparation preserves roots; an end-to-end scalar test includes cache setup and native query charges. Library/CLI/probe clippy and the local probe build pass. No performance gain is claimed before a new same-target MITM comparison.
